title: Board Clean Refactor
description: Refactor @elements/board and board integration (topology, sketchpad) to be clean: remove legacy APIs, unify naming, consolidate exports, fix inconsistencies, ensure tests pass.
summary: Canonical board fixture node captions use `text` only: removed `label` from `BoardFixtureNodeV1`, `parseBoardFixtureV1` rejects nodes with a `label` key, dropped `fontFamily` parse alias and Rust `label`→`text` fallback. Migrated 180 Nakagin graph nodes in `.storybook/fixtures/nakagin-capsule-tower.board.json` (`label`→`text`). Updated board play caption editor and Storybook. Validation: `cargo test -p elements_board` (76 passed), `bunx vitest run` in `@elements/board` (75 passed).
